content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a [product_name] [version_no] in an operational plant that uses [product_name] expansion IO modules. I am considering upgrading to [product_name] [version_no] and would prefer to keep the current expansion IO modules unchanged. Is it possible to do so, or will I also need to replace the expansion IO modules? A prompt response would be very helpful.
If you switch to [product_name] [version_no], you'll need to use the extension modules from the same series. The older extension modules are not compatible with [product_name] [version_no].
All expansion units for the [version_no] series have [article_no] at the end of their order numbers. Version numbers such as [article_no] are used for earlier versions of [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are evaluating hardware compatibility when transitioning from an older version of a [product_name] to a newer one. The main concern is whether expansion modules from the previous setup can be reused, or if additional module replacements will cause more complexity and plant downtime.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to upgrade the main controller to a newer [version_no] while keeping current expansion IO modules, ideally without needing to replace them.
